description_en: Enables or disables the certificate for a domain name and updates the certificate information
description_zh: 调用SetCdnDomainSSLCertificate用于设置某域名下证书功能是否启用及更新证书信息
kebab_example: aliyun cdn set-cdn-domain-ssl-certificate --domain-name example.com --ssl-protocol off --region cn-hangzhou
name: SetCdnDomainSSLCertificate

parameters.help_en: The accelerated domain name for which you want to configure the SSL certificate. The type of request supported by the domain name must be HTTPS. You can specify only one domain name in each request
parameters.help_zh: 指定证书所属加速域名，需属于HTTPS加速类型。仅支持单个域名
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the certificate. You can specify only one certificate name. This parameter is optional if you set CertType to upload
parameters.help_zh:
证书名称，目前只支持单个证书名称。
CertType=upload时选填，给新证书的名称
parameters.name: cert_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the certificate. This parameter is required if you set CertType to cas
parameters.help_zh:
证书ID。
CertType=cas时必填，表示选择已有证书
parameters.name: cert_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the certificate. Valid values:

upload: custom certificate

cas: a certificate that is acquired through Certificate Management Service
parameters.help_zh:
证书类型。

upload：上传证书。
cas：证书中心证书
parameters.name: cert_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the SSL certificate.

on

off
parameters.help_zh:
HTTPS证书是否启用。

on：启用。
off：不启用
parameters.name: ssl_protocol

parameters.help_en: The certificate content. Specify the certificate content only if you want to enable the certificate
parameters.help_zh: 安全证书内容，不启用证书则无需输入，配置证书请输入证书内容
parameters.name: ssl_pub

parameters.help_en: The private key. Specify the private key only if you want to enable the certificate
parameters.help_zh: 私钥内容，不启用证书则无需输入，配置证书请输入私钥内容
parameters.name: ssl_pri

parameters.help_en: The region of the certificate. This parameter takes effect only when CertType is set to cas. Valid values: cn-hangzhou and ap-southeast-1. Default value: cn-hangzhou. ap-southeast-1 is recommended for users on the International site
parameters.help_zh: 证书所在地域，只有CertType=cas时生效。支持cn-hangzhou和ap-southeast-1，默认cn-hangzhou。国际站用户建议使用ap-southeast-1
parameters.name: cert_region
